title: Quantification of microplastic targets in environmental matrices using pyrolysis-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00269E, Paper
Open Access

Rebecca H. Peel, Charlotte E. M. Lloyd, Stephen J. Roberts, B. D. A. Naafs, Ian D. Bull
Pyrolysis-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry is an effective technique for assessing microplastic pollution. Here we present the development of a protocol to determine the amount of some common microplastics in complex environmental samples.
